photos.c: The 4x400 metres final. Roger Black and Derek Redmond have done their work well and now it is up to John Regis to keep breathing down the neck of the USA's Danny Everett. The Belgravian does a fine job, leaving Kris Akabusi to wait ... and wait ... and then strike for gold in the last two metres.
